Green Smoothie
By: Denise Wetherell
Published: Thursday, December 10, 2009 - 5:39pm

Ingredients




1 large bunch of spinach
1 pineapple
1 orange
8 leaves of fresh mint
1 1/2 cups ice

Preparation

1 Add peeled orange into  blender (vitamix or alternative) 2 Then add half of your pineapple - cut into chunks 3 Place washed spinach next 4 Then add mint and ice. 5 Mix all together on high speed until smooth.... about 1 minute.

About


One way to get those greens in your diet - and very refreshing!
